project: JARVIS TRADER — Agent 2: MES Re-Validation Campaign
description: Systematically attack MES WFE=0.09 through parameter search and RL validation. Goal: find at least one parameter configuration achieving WFE≥0.40. If found, document and stage for config.py promotion (Tier 3 confirmation required). Run 50 parameter combinations via n-autoresearch experiment loop.

userStories.title: Run MES diagnostic baseline backtests
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want to establish the current WFE baseline for MES across three timeframes so I understand the failure mode before searching for fixes.
acceptanceCriteria: Run: cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python -m backtest.run_backtest --symbol MES --interval 1h 2>&1 | tee data/mes_baseline_1h.txt
Run: cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python -m backtest.run_backtest --symbol MES --interval 4h 2>&1 | tee data/mes_baseline_4h.txt
Run: cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python -m backtest.run_backtest --symbol MES --interval 1d 2>&1 | tee data/mes_baseline_1d.txt
Extract WFE, PF, Sharpe, WR from each output and record in data/mes_diagnostic_report.json
Identify which timeframe shows highest WFE
Commit: docs(data): add MES diagnostic baseline results
userStories.notes: If backtest module not found, check: ls engine/backtest/ and adapt command. If engine is not running, start it first: cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python -m uvicorn main:app --port 8010 &

userStories.title: Create MES search space JSON
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want a structured search space file covering all parameter axes that could improve MES WFE.
acceptanceCriteria: engine/backtest/mes_search_space.json created with at least 50 parameter combinations
Axes covered: stc_os (5 values), stc_ob (4 values), stc_cycle_length (4 values), atr_stop (4 values), atr_target (4 values), interval (2 values)
File follows format: [{"id": "MES-001", "stc_os": 10, "stc_ob": 80, "stc_cycle_length": 10, "atr_stop": 0.50, "atr_target": 1.20, "interval": "1h"}, ...]
Total combinations: 50-100 entries
Commit: feat(backtest): add MES parameter search space (50+ combinations)
userStories.notes: Start with tightest ATR stops for MES (smaller contract, less ATR). Prioritize 4h over 1h based on diagnostic results.

userStories.title: Implement or verify MES experiment runner
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want a script that iterates over mes_search_space.json, runs each backtest, and records WFE results.
acceptanceCriteria: Check if engine/backtest/run_experiment.py exists and supports --search-space flag
If it exists: verify it can accept mes_search_space.json
If it doesn't exist or needs extension: implement run_mes_experiment.py that reads search space, calls backtest for each config, records WFE/PF/Sharpe/WR to experiment log
Script writes results to engine/data/mes_experiment_log.json incrementally (not all-or-nothing)
Script is idempotent — can be re-run and skips already-tested configs
Commit: feat(backtest): MES experiment runner with incremental logging
userStories.notes: Incremental logging is critical — if the run crashes at iteration 40, we don't lose 39 results

userStories.title: Run MES parameter search — first 25 combinations
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want the first 25 parameter combinations tested and results recorded.
acceptanceCriteria: Run experiment runner on first 25 configs from mes_search_space.json
engine/data/mes_experiment_log.json has 25 entries with WFE, PF, Sharpe, WR
Any config achieving WFE≥0.40 is flagged in the log with 'wfe_gate_passed': true
Commit: chore(data): MES experiment log — batch 1 (25 configs)
userStories.notes: If engine pipeline LLM calls fail (Anthropic credits=0), the strategy signal generation may still work without LLM — check if backtest uses raw signals or pipeline signals

userStories.title: Run MES parameter search — second 25 combinations
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want all 50 parameter combinations tested.
acceptanceCriteria: Run experiment runner on configs 26-50 from mes_search_space.json
engine/data/mes_experiment_log.json has 50 entries total
Commit: chore(data): MES experiment log — batch 2 (50 configs total)

userStories.title: Validate RL Run 10 WFE
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want to know whether the RL Run 10 model achieves WFE≥0.40, providing an alternative path to MES paper trading.
acceptanceCriteria: Locate RL Run 10 model: find engine/data -name '*.zip' | head -10 or ls engine/data/rl_models/
Run walk-forward validation on Run 10
Record WFE in engine/data/rl_run10_wfe.json: {"run": 10, "wfe": X, "pf": X, "sharpe": X, "wr": X}
If WFE≥0.40: flag as 'gate_passed': true — this is a valid path to MES paper trading
If WFE<0.20: document recommended Run 11 config changes
Commit: docs(data): RL Run 10 WFE validation results
userStories.notes: The RL agent uses a separate signal path from STC — it may pass the gate even if STC params don't

userStories.title: Generate MES top results and promotion recommendation
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want a ranked summary of the best-performing MES configurations so Matt can make a Tier 3 decision on config.py promotion.
acceptanceCriteria: engine/data/mes_top_results.json created with top 5 configs sorted by WFE descending
Each entry includes: config params, WFE, PF, Sharpe, WR, trades count, max_dd
Document clearly: which configs (if any) pass the gate (WFE≥0.40)
Document clearly: whether RL Run 10 passes the gate
Create data/MES_ACTIVATION_BRIEF.md summarizing findings and next steps for Tier 3 config.py promotion
Commit: docs: MES activation brief — top results and promotion recommendation
userStories.notes: config.py promotion requires explicit Tier 3 confirmation from Matt — this story documents the case, not makes the change
